strings.jp:
ケンカは強いが、あまりにも無茶苦茶な
彼の行動には、敵も味方も誰も
ついていけなかったという…
strings.en:
He was tough in a brawl, but his
antics were so outrageous that
neither friend nor foe could
keep up with him...

strings.jp:
彼の無謀さが天然だということが分かり
味方は一様に愕然としたが、その情報は
ひた隠しにされたという…
strings.en:
When it came out that his
recklessness was natural, his
allies were aghast, and the fact
was kept a strict secret...

strings.jp:
彼の鬼神の如く戦う姿には
敵も味方も付近の住民でさえも
例外なく恐怖したという…
strings.en:
The sight of him fighting like a
demon god terrified friend, foe,
and even the locals, without
exception...

strings.jp:
戦場で発揮される彼の超人的な力は、
多くの者に古の狂戦士の再来を
思わせたという…
strings.en:
The superhuman strength he
showed on the battlefield made
many think a berserker of old
had returned...

strings.jp:
その威圧感とその圧倒的な破壊力は
彼を見た者に伝説の凶戦士の再来を
思わせたという…
strings.en:
His overwhelming presence and
destructive power made all who
saw him think a fiend of legend
had returned...

strings.jp:
そのあたかも燃えるような彼の猛々しい
姿は、何人をも恐怖のどん底へと
叩き落したという…
strings.en:
The fierce sight of him, as if he
were ablaze, cast everyone into
the depths of terror...

strings.jp:
彼のそのあまりの無謀っぷりに
呆れた家臣たちは、ついに暇を
要求したという…
strings.en:
Fed up with his sheer
recklessness, his retainers at
last asked to be dismissed...

strings.jp:
家臣の言に耳を貸さず、思った通りにしか
行動しないそのワンマン振りに
家臣たちは皆ため息をついたという…
strings.en:
Deaf to his retainers, he only
ever did as he pleased, and at
this one-man show his retainers
could only sigh...

strings.jp:
涙も涸れんばかりの彼の冷徹振りに
鬼の姿を重ねる家臣も大勢いたと
伝えられている…
strings.en:
Many retainers saw an ogre in
his coldness, cold enough to
dry up all tears, so it is said...

strings.jp:
激情の赴くままに大鎌を振るう
その勇姿に、伝説の魔竜の姿を重ねる者も
少なくなかったという…
strings.en:
Seeing him swing his great
scythe wherever his passions
led, not a few saw in him the
legendary demon dragon...

strings.jp:
彼がまとうその災のオーラを見た者は
皆一様に戦慄を覚え、あたかも背筋が
凍りつくような恐怖を感じたという…
strings.en:
All who saw the aura of
calamity around him
shuddered, gripped by a terror
that froze them to the spine...

strings.jp:
そのあまりにも尊大で圧倒的な
破壊力の前に、全ての人々が畏れ
ひれ伏したという…
strings.en:
Before his utterly arrogant and
overwhelming destructive
power, all people bowed down
in awe...
